Community Tree Lighting

Friday, December 4

6 p.m. to 8 p.m.

Quinlan Community Center 10185 North Stelling Road

Kick off the holiday season. Experience the moment when the tree comes alive with hundreds of twinkling lights, filling the air with a magical glow. Stay for holiday photo opportunities including a photo with Santa, our snowball room, holiday movie watching, and kids activities. This is a free event open to the community. No registration is required.
